data.body_html:
New Year's Eve in Puerto Banús is one of the Costa del Sol's most glamorous celebrations. The harbour fills with superyachts, the restaurants spill onto the promenade, and at midnight a 15-minute fireworks display lights up the sky over the marina. Watching from a private yacht is the best seat in the house. Our fleet of 16 boats, from 6.4m speedboats to 29m superyachts, all depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% IVA. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. Here is everything you need to plan your Puerto Banús NYE 2042 yacht charter.

Where to Anchor for the Best Fireworks View

The fireworks launch from the harbour mouth between the two breakwaters. The best views are from boats anchored just outside the harbour, 100–200m off the beach of the Golden Mile. This gives you a full, unobstructed panorama of the display and the marina lights behind it. Another option is anchoring off Cabopino, 3 NM east, where the skyline includes the whole bay. Our skippers know the best spots and will position your boat for the show. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, so you are minutes from the action.

Our NYE Fleet: From Speedboats to Superyachts

We have boats for every group size and budget. Here are the most popular choices for NYE:

All prices include skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA. No hidden costs. For Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80, a 4-hour minimum applies and a jet ski is included free. For all other boats, contact us via WhatsApp for a quote.

What to Expect on the Night

December evenings in Marbella average 14°C, so bring a warm jacket or jumper. The boat will be lit and heated if possible. Your skipper will anchor by 10pm so you can settle in with a glass of cava. At midnight, the fireworks launch. After the display, you can cruise back to Puerto Banús or stay anchored to watch the celebrations on land. Our 8-hour charters are ideal if you want to enjoy dinner on board or head to a restaurant after. For a shorter evening, the 2-hour option covers the fireworks and a short cruise.

How to Book Your NYE 2042 Yacht Charter

NYE is our busiest night of the year. Boats start booking in October and are usually fully reserved by mid-December. To secure your preferred boat, contact us via WhatsApp with your group size, budget, and preferred time. We will confirm availability and send a payment link. All charters are confirmed with a 50% deposit. Balance is due 7 days before departure. We recommend booking by November 2042 for the best choice.

Add a Jet Ski for Extra Fun

All Tier B charters (Mangusta 80 and Mangusta 80 Grey) include a free jet ski. You can ride it in the bay before the fireworks or during the day if you charter for 4+ hours. Jet ski use is supervised by the skipper. For other boats, jet ski rental can be added on request. It is a popular addition for NYE groups who want to combine a sunset cruise with some adrenaline.

Fireworks launch at midnight sharp, 31 December 2042. The main display lasts about 12–15 minutes over the harbour mouth. Many boats anchor from 10pm onwards to enjoy the atmosphere and countdown.

Which boat is best for a group of 12 for NYE?

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offer ample deck space and panoramic views. The Mangusta 80 also includes a free jet ski. Both depart from Puerto Banús.

Can we bring our own food and drinks?

All our charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You are welcome to bring extra food or drinks. The skipper will help store and serve them.

Prices are per boat, not per person. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. All include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% IVA.

The skipper will assess conditions. If the charter is unsafe, we reschedule or fully refund. December evenings in Marbella average 14°C, so bring a jacket.

How far in advance should I book for NYE 2042?

Can we watch the fireworks from a speedboat?

Yes. The Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) can anchor near the harbour for close-up views. Both are budget-friendly and include a skipper.

Do you provide a skipper for NYE charters?

Every charter includes a licensed English-speaking skipper. You do not need a licence. The skipper handles navigation, anchoring, and safety.
